content.zekr_arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ. اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ لاَ تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلاَ نَوْمٌ لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الأَرْضِ مَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلاَّ بِإِذْنِهِ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلاَ يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلاَّ بِمَا شَاءَ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضَ وَلاَ يَئُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ.
content.zekr_english: I seek refuge in Allah from Satan the outcast. Allah! There is no god but He, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of [all] existence. Neither slumber nor sleep overtakes Him. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is before them and what will be after them, and they encompass not a thing of His knowledge except for what He wills. His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth, and He is not wearied by their preservation. And He is the Most High, the Most Great.
content.zekr_english_transliteration: A'oothu billaahi minash-Shaytaanir-rajeem. Allaahu laa ilaaha illaa Huwal-Hayyul-Qayyoomu laa ta'khuthuhu sinatun wa laa nawmun lahu maa fis-samaawaati wa maa fil-ardi man thal-lathee yashfa'u 'indahu illaa bi'ithnihi ya'lamu maa bayna aydeehim wa maa khalfahum wa laa yuheetoona bishay'in min 'ilmihi illaa bimaa shaa'a wasi'a kursiyyuhus-samaawaati wal-arda wa laa ya'ooduhu hifthuhumaa wa Huwal-'Aliyyul-'Adheem.
content.bless_arabic: من قالها حين يمسي أجير من الجن حتى يصبح.
content.bless_english: Whoever recites it in the evening will be protected from jinn until morning.
content.source: Al-Hakim 1/562, graded Sahih by Al-Albani in Sahih At-Targheeb wat-Tarheeb 1/273.

content.zekr_arabic: قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ. اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ. لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ. وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ.
content.zekr_english: Say, 'He is Allah, [who is] One, Allah, the Eternal Refuge. He neither begets nor is born, Nor is there to Him any equivalent.'
content.zekr_english_transliteration: Qul Huwallaahu Ahad. Allaahus-Samad. Lam yalid wa lam yoolad. Wa lam yakullahu kufuwan ahad.
content.bless_arabic: تكفيك من كل شيء.
content.bless_english: They will suffice you against everything.
content.source: Sunan Abu Dawud 4/322, Sunan at-Tirmidhi 5/567. Graded Hasan by Al-Albani. (To be recited with Surah Al-Falaq and An-Nas).

content.zekr_arabic: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ. مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ. وَمِنْ شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ. وَمِنْ شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ. وَمِنْ شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ.
content.zekr_english: Say, 'I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak from the evil of that which He created; And from the evil of darkness when it settles; And from the evil of the blowers in knots; And from the evil of an envier when he envies.'
content.zekr_english_transliteration: Qul a'oothu bi Rabbil-falaq. Min sharri maa khalaq. Wa min sharri ghaasiqin ithaa waqab. Wa min sharrin-naffathaati fil-'uqad. Wa min sharri haasidin ithaa hasad.
content.bless_arabic: تكفيك من كل شيء.
content.bless_english: They will suffice you against everything.
content.source: Sunan Abu Dawud 4/322, Sunan at-Tirmidhi 5/567. Graded Hasan by Al-Albani. (To be recited with Surah Al-Ikhlas and An-Nas).

content.zekr_arabic: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ. مَلِكِ النَّاسِ. إِلَهِ النَّاسِ. مِنْ شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ. الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ. مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ.
content.zekr_english: Say, 'I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, The Sovereign of mankind, The God of mankind, From the evil of the retreating whisperer - Who whispers [evil] into the breasts of mankind - From among the jinn and mankind.'
content.zekr_english_transliteration: Qul a'oothu bi Rabbin-naas. Malikin-naas. Ilaahin-naas. Min sharril-waswaasil-khannaas. Allathee yuwaswisu fee sudoorin-naas. Minal-jinnati wannaas.
content.bless_arabic: تكفيك من كل شيء.
content.bless_english: They will suffice you against everything.
content.source: Sunan Abu Dawud 4/322, Sunan at-Tirmidhi 5/567. Graded Hasan by Al-Albani. (To be recited with Surah Al-Ikhlas and Al-Falaq).

content.zekr_arabic: أَمْسَيْنَا وَأَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ. رَبِّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا فِي هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ وَخَيْرَ مَا بَعْدَهَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِي هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهَا. رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ وَسُوءِ الْكِبَرِ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ فِي النَّارِ وَعَذَابٍ فِي الْقَبْرِ.
content.zekr_english: We have entered the evening and at this very time, the whole kingdom belongs to Allah, and all praise is for Allah. There is no god but Allah alone, He has no partners. To Him belongs the dominion and to Him belongs all praise, and He is over all things competent. My Lord, I ask You for the good of this night and the good of what comes after it, and I seek refuge in You from the evil of this night and the evil of what comes after it. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from laziness and the evil of old age. My Lord, I seek refuge in You from a torment in the Fire and a torment in the grave.
content.zekr_english_transliteration: Amsaynaa wa amsal-mulku lillaah walhamdu lillaah, laa ilaaha illallaahu wahdahu laa shareeka lahu, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa Huwa 'alaa kulli shay'in Qadeer. Rabbi as'aluka khayra maa fee haathihil-laylati wa khayra maa ba'dahaa, wa a'oodhu bika min sharri maa fee haathihil-laylati wa sharri maa ba'dahaa. Rabbi a'oodhu bika minal-kasali wa soo'il-kibari, Rabbi a'oodhu bika min 'adhaabin fin-naari wa 'adhaabin fil-qabr.
content.bless_arabic: دعاء شامل لخير الدنيا والآخرة والحماية من الشرور.
content.bless_english: A comprehensive supplication for the good of this world and the Hereafter, and protection from evils.
content.source: Sahih Muslim 4/2088.

content.zekr_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا، وَبِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا، وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ.
content.zekr_english: O Allah, by You we have entered the evening, and by You we have entered the morning, and by You we live, and by You we die, and to You is the return.
content.zekr_english_transliteration: Allaahumma bika amsaynaa, wa bika asbahnaa, wa bika nahyaa, wa bika namootu wa ilaykal-maseer.
content.bless_arabic: إقرار بالتوكل على الله في كل شؤون الحياة والممات.
content.bless_english: An affirmation of reliance on Allah in all matters of life and death.
content.source: Sunan at-Tirmidhi 5/466, graded Sahih by Al-Albani.

content.zekr_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لاَ إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لاَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ.
content.zekr_english: O Allah, You are my Lord. There is no god but You. You created me and I am Your slave, and I am faithful to Your covenant and Your promise as much as I can. I seek refuge with You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge Your favor upon me, and I acknowledge my sin. So forgive me, for indeed, none can forgive sins except You.
content.zekr_english_transliteration: Allaahumma Anta Rabbee laa ilaaha illaa Anta, khalaqtanee wa anaa 'abduka, wa anaa 'alaa 'ahdika wa wa'dika mas-tata'tu, a'oodhu bika min sharri maa sana'tu, aboo'u laka bi ni'matika 'alayya, wa aboo'u bi dhanbee faghfir lee fa'innahu laa yaghfirudh-dhunooba illaa Anta.
content.bless_arabic: من قالها من الليل وهو موقن بها فمات قبل أن يصبح فهو من أهل الجنة، ومن قالها من النهار موقنا بها فمات من يومه قبل أن يمسي فهو من أهل الجنة.
content.bless_english: Whoever says it at night, believing in it firmly, and dies before morning, will be among the people of Paradise; and whoever says it during the day, believing in it firmly, and dies on that day before evening, will be among the people of Paradise.
content.source: Sahih Bukhari 7/150.

content.zekr_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَمْسَيْتُ أُشْهِدُكَ وَأُشْهِدُ حَمَلَةَ عَرْشِكَ، وَمَلاَئِكَتَكَ، وَجَمِيعَ خَلْقِكَ، أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ وَحْدَكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ، وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُكَ وَرَسُولُكَ.
content.zekr_english: O Allah, I have entered the evening and I call upon You to bear witness, and upon the bearers of Your Throne, and upon Your angels, and upon all creation, that You are Allah, there is no god but You alone, You have no partners, and that Muhammad is Your slave and Your Messenger.
content.zekr_english_transliteration: Allaahumma innee amsaytu ush-hiduka wa ush-hidu hamalata 'arshika, wa malaa'ikataka, wa jamee'a khalqika, annaka Antal-laahu laa ilaaha illaa Anta wahdaka laa shareeka laka, wa anna Muhammadan 'abduka wa Rasooluka.
content.bless_arabic: من قالها حين يصبح أو يمسي أعتقه الله من النار.
content.bless_english: Whoever says it in the morning or evening, Allah will free him from the Hellfire.
content.source: Sunan Abu Dawud 4/317. Graded Sahih by Al-Albani in Sahih Al-Adab Al-Mufrad no. 1201.

content.zekr_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ مَا أَمْسَى بِي مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ أَوْ بِأَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ فَمِنْكَ وَحْدَكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ، فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَلَكَ الشُّكْرُ.
content.zekr_english: O Allah, whatever blessing has come to me or to any of Your creation in the evening, it is from You alone, You have no partners. So to You belongs all praise and to You belongs all thanks.
content.zekr_english_transliteration: Allaahumma maa amsaa bee min ni'matin aw bi'ahadin min khalqika faminka wahdaka laa shareeka laka, falakal-hamdu wa lakash-shukr.
content.bless_arabic: من قالها حين يمسي فقد أدى شكر ليلته.
content.bless_english: Whoever says it in the evening will have fulfilled the thanks of his night.
content.source: Sunan Abu Dawud 4/318. Graded Hasan by Ibn Baz and Al-Albani.

content.zekr_arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لاَ يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلاَ فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ.
content.zekr_english: In the Name of Allah, with Whose Name nothing can cause harm in the earth nor in the heaven, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
content.zekr_english_transliteration: Bismillaahil-ladhee laa yadurru ma'asmihi shay'un fil-ardi wa laa fis-samaa'i wa Huwas-Samee'ul-'Aleem.
content.bless_arabic: لم يضره شيء.
content.bless_english: Nothing will harm him.
content.source: Sunan Abu Dawud 4/323, Sunan at-Tirmidhi 5/134. Graded Hasan Sahih by Al-Albani.

content.zekr_arabic: رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبًّا، وَبِالإِسْلَامِ دِينًا، وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ نَبِيًّا.
content.zekr_english: I am pleased with Allah as my Lord, and with Islam as my religion, and with Muhammad (peace be upon him) as my Prophet.
content.zekr_english_transliteration: Radheetu billaahi Rabban, wa bil-Islaami deenan, wa bi Muhammadin Nabiyyan.
content.bless_arabic: كان حقًّا على الله أن يرضيه يوم القيامة.
content.bless_english: It is a right upon Allah to make him pleased on the Day of Resurrection.
content.source: Sunan Abu Dawud 4/322, Musnad Ahmad 4/337. Graded Hasan by Al-Albani.

content.zekr_arabic: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغِيثُ، أَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِي كُلَّهُ، وَلاَ تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ.
content.zekr_english: O Ever-Living, O Sustainer! By Your Mercy I seek deliverance. Rectify all my affairs, and do not entrust me to my soul for the blink of an eye.
content.zekr_english_transliteration: Yaa Hayyu yaa Qayyoomu bi Rahmatika astagheethu, aslih lee sha'nee kullahu, wa laa takilnee ilaa nafsee tarfata 'ayn.
content.bless_arabic: استغاثة بالله وتوكل عليه في كل أمور الحياة.
content.bless_english: Seeking Allah's help and relying on Him in all matters of life.
content.source: An-Nasa'i in Al-Kubra, Al-Hakim 1/545. Graded Hasan by Al-Albani in Sahih At-Targheeb wat-Tarheeb 1/273.

content.zekr_arabic: أَمْسَيْنَا عَلَى فِطْرَةِ الْإِسْلاَمِ، وَعَلَى كَلِمَةِ الْإِخْلاَصِ، وَعَلَى دِينِ نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ، وَعَلَى مِلَّةِ أَبِينَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ حَنِيفًا مُسْلِمًا وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ.
content.zekr_english: We have entered the evening upon the natural disposition of Islam, and upon the word of sincerity, and upon the religion of our Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him), and upon the creed of our father Ibrahim, who was a pure monotheist and not of the polytheists.
content.zekr_english_transliteration: Amsaynaa 'alaa fitratil-Islaami, wa 'alaa kalimatil-ikhlaasi, wa 'alaa deeni Nabiyyinaa Muhammadin sallallaahu 'alayhi wa sallama, wa 'alaa millati abeenaa Ibraaheema haneefan musliman wa maa kaana minal-mushrikeen.
content.bless_arabic: تجديد للعهد بالإسلام وتوحيد الله سبحانه وتعالى.
content.bless_english: A renewal of commitment to Islam and the Oneness of Allah (SWT).
content.source: Musnad Ahmad 3/406-407, Ibn As-Sunni in 'Amalul-Yawm wal-Laylah no. 34. Graded Sahih by Al-Albani in Sahih Al-Jaami' no. 4/451.

content.zekr_arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ، وَرِضَا نَفْسِهِ، وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ، وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ.
content.zekr_english: Glory be to Allah and praise be to Him, (in a quantity) equal to the number of His creation, and in proportion to His Pleasure, and the weight of His Throne, and the ink of His words.
content.zekr_english_transliteration: Subhaanallaahi wa bihamdihi 'adada khalqihi, wa ridaa nafsihi, wa zinata 'arshihi, wa midaada kalimaatihi.
content.bless_arabic: تعادل أضعاف الأذكار الأخرى في الأجر.
content.bless_english: It equates to many times the reward of other remembrances.
content.source: Sahih Muslim 4/2090.

content.zekr_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَدَنِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي سَمْعِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَصَرِي، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ. اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكُفْرِ وَالْفَقْرِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ.
content.zekr_english: O Allah, make me healthy in my body. O Allah, make me healthy in my hearing. O Allah, make me healthy in my sight. There is no god but You. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from disbelief and poverty. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the torment of the grave. There is no god but You.
content.zekr_english_transliteration: Allaahumma 'aafinee fee badanee, Allaahumma 'aafinee fee sam'ee, Allaahumma 'aafinee fee basaree, laa ilaaha illaa Anta. Allaahumma innee a'oodhu bika minal-kufri wal-faqri, Allaahumma innee a'oodhu bika min 'adhaabil-qabri, laa ilaaha illaa Anta.
content.bless_arabic: طلب العافية والسلامة في الدنيا والآخرة.
content.bless_english: Seeking well-being and safety in this world and the Hereafter.
content.source: Sunan Abu Dawud 4/324, Musnad Ahmad 5/42. Graded Hasan by Al-Albani.

content.zekr_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَايَ وَأَهْلِي وَمَالِي، اللَّهُمَّ اسْتُرْ عَوْرَاتِي وَآمِنْ رَوْعَاتِي، اللَّهُمَّ احْفَظْنِي مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيَّ وَمِنْ خَلْفِي وَعَنْ يَمِينِي وَعَنْ شِمَالِي وَمِنْ فَوْقِي، وَأَعُوذُ بِعَظَمَتِكَ أَنْ أُغْتَالَ مِنْ تَحْتِي.
content.zekr_english: O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in this world and the Hereafter. O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in my religious affairs, my worldly affairs, my family, and my wealth. O Allah, conceal my flaws and calm my fears. O Allah, protect me from before me, and from behind me, and from my right, and from my left, and from above me, and I seek refuge in Your Greatness from being unexpectedly assaulted from below me.
content.zekr_english_transliteration: Allaahumma innee as'alukal-'afwa wal-'aafiyata fid-dunyaa wal-aakhirati, Allaahumma innee as'alukal-'afwa wal-'aafiyata fee deenee wa dunyaaya wa ahlee wa maalee, Allaahummastur 'awraatee wa aamin raw'aatee, Allaahummahfaznee min bayni yadayya wa min khalfee wa 'an yameenee wa 'an shimaalee wa min fawqee, wa a'oodhu bi 'adhamatika an ughtaala min tahtee.
content.bless_arabic: دعاء شامل للحفظ والحماية من كل الشرور في كل الأوقات.
content.bless_english: A comprehensive supplication for protection from all evils at all times.
content.source: Sunan Abu Dawud 4/324, Ibn Majah 2/332. Graded Sahih by Al-Albani.

content.zekr_arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ.
content.zekr_english: There is no god but Allah alone, He has no partners. To Him belongs the dominion and to Him belongs all praise, and He is over all things competent.
content.zekr_english_transliteration: Laa ilaaha illallaahu wahdahu laa shareeka lahu, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa Huwa 'alaa kulli shay'in Qadeer.
content.bless_arabic: كانت له عدل عشر رقاب، وكتبت له مائة حسنة، ومحيت عنه مائة سيئة، وكانت له حرزا من الشيطان يومه ذلك حتى يمسي، ولم يأت أحد بأفضل مما جاء به إلا رجل عمل أكثر منه.
content.bless_english: It will be equivalent to freeing ten slaves, one hundred good deeds will be recorded for him, one hundred evil deeds will be erased from him, and it will be a protection for him from Satan on that day until evening, and no one will come with anything better than what he came with except for a man who did more than him.
content.source: Sahih Bukhari 4/95, Sahih Muslim 4/2071. (This version is for 100 times, there's also a 10 times version with different reward).

content.zekr_arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ.
content.zekr_english: Glory be to Allah and praise be to Him.
content.zekr_english_transliteration: Subhaanallaahi wa bihamdihi.
content.bless_arabic: غفرت خطاياه وإن كانت مثل زبد البحر.
content.bless_english: His sins will be forgiven, even if they are like the foam of the sea.
content.source: Sahih Muslim 4/2071.

content.zekr_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَمْسَيْتُ أُشْهِدُكَ وَأُشْهِدُ حَمَلَةَ عَرْشِكَ، وَمَلاَئِكَتَكَ، وَجَمِيعَ خَلْقِكَ، أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ وَحْدَكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ، وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُكَ وَرَسُولُكَ.
content.zekr_english: O Allah, I have entered the evening and I call upon You to bear witness, and upon the bearers of Your Throne, and upon Your angels, and upon all creation, that You are Allah, there is no god but You alone, You have no partners, and that Muhammad is Your slave and Your Messenger.
content.zekr_english_transliteration: Allaahumma innee amsaytu ush-hiduka wa ush-hidu hamalata 'arshika, wa malaa'ikataka, wa jamee'a khalqika, annaka Antal-laahu laa ilaaha illaa Anta wahdaka laa shareeka laka, wa anna Muhammadan 'abduka wa Rasooluka.
content.bless_arabic: من قالها حين يصبح أو يمسي أعتقه الله من النار.
content.bless_english: Whoever says it in the morning or evening, Allah will free him from the Hellfire.
content.source: Sunan Abu Dawud 4/317. Graded Sahih by Al-Albani in Sahih Al-Adab Al-Mufrad no. 1201.

content.zekr_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْجُبْنِ وَالْبُخْلِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ غَلَبَةِ الدَّيْنِ وَقَهْرِ الرِّجَالِ.
content.zekr_english: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from anxiety and sorrow, and I seek refuge in You from helplessness and laziness, and I seek refuge in You from cowardice and stinginess, and I seek refuge in You from the burden of debt and from being overpowered by men.
content.zekr_english_transliteration: Allaahumma innee a'oodhu bika minal-hammi wal-hazani, wa a'oodhu bika minal-'ajzi wal-kasali, wa a'oodhu bika minal-jubni wal-bukhli, wa a'oodhu bika min ghalabatid-dayni wa qahrir-rijaal.
content.bless_arabic: من قالها أذهب الله همه وقضى دينه.
content.bless_english: Whoever says it, Allah will remove his worries and settle his debts.
content.source: Sunan Abu Dawud 4/324. Graded Sahih by Al-Albani.

content.zekr_arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ الْعَظِيمَ الَّذِي لاَ إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيَّ الْقَيُّومَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ.
content.zekr_english: I seek forgiveness from Allah, the Magnificent, Whom there is none worthy of worship except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer, and I repent to Him.
content.zekr_english_transliteration: Astaghfirullaahal-'Adheemal-ladhee laa ilaaha illaa Huwal-Hayyul-Qayyoomu wa atoobu ilayh.
content.bless_arabic: غفرت له ذنوبه وإن فر من الزحف.
content.bless_english: His sins will be forgiven, even if he fled from battle.
content.source: Sunan Abu Dawud 2/85, Sunan at-Tirmidhi 5/569. Graded Sahih by Al-Albani.

content.zekr_arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ.
content.zekr_english: Glory be to Allah and praise be to Him, Glory be to Allah, the Most Great.
content.zekr_english_transliteration: Subhaanallaahi wa bihamdihi, Subhaanallaahil-'Adheem.
content.bless_arabic: ثقيلتان في الميزان، حبيبتان إلى الرحمن.
content.bless_english: Two phrases that are light on the tongue but heavy on the scale, beloved to the Most Merciful.
content.source: Sahih Bukhari 7/168, Sahih Muslim 4/2072. (General virtue, applicable for morning and evening).

content.zekr_arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ.
content.zekr_english: There is no god but Allah alone, He has no partners. To Him belongs the dominion and to Him belongs all praise. He gives life and causes death, and He is over all things competent.
content.zekr_english_transliteration: Laa ilaaha illallaahu wahdahu laa shareeka lahu, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu, yuhyee wa yumeetu wa Huwa 'alaa kulli shay'in Qadeer.
content.bless_arabic: من قالها عشر مرات كتب الله له عشر حسنات، ومحا عنه عشر سيئات، ورفع له عشر درجات، وكان له كعتق أربع رقاب، وحفظ من كل سوء حتى يصبح.
content.bless_english: Whoever says it ten times, Allah will write ten good deeds for him, erase ten evil deeds from him, raise him ten degrees, it will be like freeing four slaves, and he will be protected from all evil until morning.
content.source: Musnad Ahmad 4/60, Sunan at-Tirmidhi 5/521. Graded Hasan by Al-Albani.

content.zekr_arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ.
content.zekr_english: O Allah, send blessings and peace upon our Prophet Muhammad.
content.zekr_english_transliteration: Allaahumma salli wa sallim 'alaa Nabiyyinaa Muhammadin.
content.bless_arabic: من صلى عليَّ حين يصبح عشراً وحين يمسي عشراً أدركته شفاعتي يوم القيامة.
content.bless_english: Whoever sends blessings upon me ten times in the morning and ten times in the evening, my intercession will reach him on the Day of Resurrection.
content.source: At-Tabarani, graded Sahih by Al-Albani in Sahih At-Targheeb wat-Tarheeb 1/273.

content.zekr_arabic: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلَّا هُوَ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ.
content.zekr_english: Allah is sufficient for me; there is no god but He. Upon Him I rely, and He is the Lord of the Great Throne.
content.zekr_english_transliteration: Hasbiyallaahu laa ilaaha illaa Huwa 'alayhi tawakkaltu wa Huwa Rabbul-'Arshil-'Adheem.
content.bless_arabic: من قالها كفاه الله ما أهمه من أمر دنياه وآخرته.
content.bless_english: Whoever says it, Allah will suffice him for whatever concerns him in this world and the Hereafter.
content.source: Sunan Abu Dawud 4/321. Authenticity debated by some scholars (graded Da'if by others), but widely included in compilations like Hisn al-Muslim and accepted for Fada'il al-A'mal (virtues of deeds).
